ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience upon 30 days' prior written notice to Vendor, and Vendor shall provide a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor may not terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience during a committed term.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a Customer-only convenience exit on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, because Section 8.1 runs three years with no convenience right for either Party. This is our preferred position and the new Section 9.4 leaves Sections 9.1-9.3 and 9.5 untouched.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 9.4 giving Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees and barring Vendor convenience termination during a committed term.

mappings.element: No more than 30 days' written notice.
No Vendor termination-for-convenience right during a committed term.
